user_story: As a user, I want registration to fail if I leave any field empty so that incomplete accounts are not created.

positive.title: Successful registration with all fields filled
steps: Fill in the username field with a valid username.
Fill in the password field with a valid password.
Fill in the email field with a valid email address.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Registration fails with empty username field
steps: Fill in the password field with a valid password.
Fill in the email field with a valid email address.
negative.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that the username field is required.

negative.title: Registration fails with empty password field
steps: Fill in the username field with a valid username.
Fill in the email field with a valid email address.
negative.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that the password field is required.

negative.title: Registration fails with empty email field
steps: Fill in the username field with a valid username.
Fill in the password field with a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Registration fails with fields containing only whitespace
steps: Fill in the username field with whitespace (e.g., '   ').
Fill in the password field with whitespace (e.g., '   ').
Fill in the email field with whitespace (e.g., '   ').
edge.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that all fields are required and cannot be empty or only whitespace.
